weapons.name: Great Sword
weapons.description: Deals 35-55% of your STR to all opponents.

weapons.name: Healing Staff
weapons.description: Heals 110-160% of your MAG to the lowest health ally. This weapon can overheal up to 50% of max HP.

weapons.name: Bow
weapons.description: Deals 110-160% of your STR to a an enemy.

weapons.name: Rune of the Forgotten
weapons.description: Increase ALL stats by 5-15%, and changes your physical attacks to do 65% STR and 65% MAG as TRUE damage. This weapon does not have an active ability.

weapons.name: Defender's Aegis
weapons.description: At the start of the turn, apply taunt to your animal for 2 turns. taunt Taunts the enemy team and forces all opponents to attack this animal. Reduces incoming damage by -20-50%. 24px Defense Buff - Cannot be applied if the animal already has a defense buff.

weapons.name: Orb of Potency
weapons.description: This weapon has no active ability, but comes with two passives!

weapons.name: Vampiric Staff
weapons.description: Deal 25-45% of your MAG to ALL enemies and heal ALL allies by the damage dealt.

weapons.name: Poison Dagger
weapons.description: Deals 70-100% of your STR to an enemy and apply poison for 3 turns. poison Deals 30-50% of your MAG as true damage at the end of the turn.

weapons.name: Wand of Absorption
weapons.description: Deal 80-115% of your MAG to an enemy and transfer their WP to any random ally equal to 20-40% of the damage done.

weapons.name: Flame Staff
weapons.description: Deals 75-95% of your MAG to an enemy and apply flame for 3 turns. flame Deals 20-40% of your MAG at the end of the turn. Applying flame on a target that already has flame will explode and deal 80-110% damage to the target.

weapons.name: Energy Staff
weapons.description: Sends a wave of energy and deals 35-65% of your MAG to all opponents.

weapons.name: Spirit Staff
weapons.description: Heal all allies for 30-50% of your MAG and apply defup for 2 turns. defup Reduces incoming damage by -20-30%. 24px Defense Buff - Cannot be applied if the animal already has a defense buff.

weapons.name: Arcane Scepter
weapons.description: Replenish 65-95% of your MAG as WP to any ally with the lowest WP. This weapon can overreplenish up to 50% of max WP.

weapons.name: Resurrection Staff
weapons.description: Revive a random dead ally and heal them for 60-90% of your MAG.

weapons.name: Glacial Axe
weapons.description: Deals 40-60% of your STR to an enemy and apply 2 stacks of freeze. freeze Next turn, prevent the target from attacking. Remove a stack after triggering.

weapons.name: Vanguard's Banner
weapons.description: At the start of the turn, apply atkup to all allies for 2 turns. If the user has enough WP when the buff expires, the buff will be recasted with a stronger version. atkupIncreases all damage by +15-25%. Cannot stack with other Attack Up buffs. atkup+Increases all damage by +25-35%. Cannot stack with other Attack Up+ buffs. atkup++Increases all damage by +40-50%. Cannot stack with other Attack Up++ buffs.

weapons.name: Culling Scythe
weapons.description: Deals 70-100% of your STR to an enemy and apply mort for 2 turns. mort Decreases all healing for this animal by -45-75%

weapons.name: Rune of Celebration
weapons.description: Apply celeb to an ally with the lowest health for 3 turns. celeb At the end of every turn, heal 20-45% of your PR as HP and restore 15-35% of your MR as WP.

weapons.name: Staff of Purity
weapons.description: Remove a debuff from a random ally and heal them for 50-100% of your MAG and apply 1 stack of sward for 2 turns. sward Prevents any debuffs to be applied to this animal. On success, remove a stack and replenish 15-25% MAG to the animal.

weapons.name: Leeching Scythe
weapons.description: Deal 50-80% of your STR to an enemy and apply leech for 3 turns. If leech is already on the target, deal +40-60% more damage. leech The caster who applied this debuff steals -30-60% of incoming heals and -30-60% of incoming replenishes.

weapons.name: Foul Fish
weapons.description: Deal 50-80% of your STR to an enemy and apply stinky for 2 turns. stinky prevents any future buffs AND debuffs to be applied to this animal. On success, deal 20-50% MAG to the animal. Stinky can be applied to stinky animals.

weapons.name: Rune of Luck
weapons.description: Punches an enemy 5 times. Each punch randomly deals either a percentage of your STR or MAG. Punches deals: 1-40%, 1-40%, 1-40%, 1-40%, 1-40%.

weapons.name: Staff of Corruption
weapons.description: Reduce the effectiveness of a random enemy's buff to 70-50% of its original value, and deal 80-120 of your STR to them.

weapons.name: Soul Tithe
weapons.description: Absorb 10-25% of all allies' current WP to deal damage to an enemy. Deals 35-45% of your MAG for every 100 WP absorbed.

weapons.name: Briar-Heart Staff
weapons.description: At the start of the turn, apply tether to your allies for 2 turns. tether Create a tether from the weapon owner to this animal. The owner absorbs -25-50% of the incoming damage dealt, but also intercepts -20-30% of healing and -20-30% replenishing from the target. 24px Defense Buff - Cannot be applied if the animal already has a defense buff.

weapons.name: Arbiter's Edge
weapons.description: Unleash judgement upon an enemy. Consume all stacks of sin and vir. Gain a stack of sin when an ally deals damage to an animal. Gain a stack of vir when an ally heals or replenishes an animal. sin When consumed, each stack deals 10-20% of your MIXED highest offense stat as physical damage to an enemy. vir When consumed, each stack deals 20-30% of your MIXED lowest offense stat as magical damage to an enemy. 24px Stack Limit - Cannot exceed 10 stacks

weapons.name: Wounding Crossbow
weapons.description: If arrow is not loaded, load one. Otherwise, consume it. Loading an arrow does not cost WP. arrow When consumed, deal 220-300% of your STR and apply 10-25 stacks of exposed to an enemy. exposed The next instance of damage taken will be increased by 1% per stack. Consume all stacks after triggering.

weapons.name: Bleeding Gaze
weapons.description: Force a random enemy to attack its allies with 30-50% weapon Effectiveness. Their weapon's cost is reduced to 20-40% during this attack. If there is only one enemy, deal 150-200% of your MAG directly to the enemy.

weapons.name: Conduit Claw
weapons.description: Move a debuff from an enemy to the ally with the most buffs. Reduce the debuff's effectiveness by -20-50% and deal 120-170% of your MAG to the enemy. Moved buffs are calculated based on the original caster's stats. |}

passives.name: Strength
passives.description: Increases your STR by 5-20%.

passives.name: Magic
passives.description: Increases your MAG by 5-20%.

passives.name: Health Point
passives.description: Increases your HP by 5-20%.

passives.name: Weapon Point
passives.description: Increases your WP by 10-30%.

passives.name: Physical Resistance
passives.description: Increases your PR by 15-35%.

passives.name: Magic Resistance
passives.description: Increases your MR by 15-35%.

passives.name: Lifesteal
passives.description: All damage you deal heals you for 15-35% of the damage dealt!

passives.name: Thorns
passives.description: Reflect 15-35% of the damage dealt to you as true damage.

passives.name: Mana Tap
passives.description: All Damage you deal replenishes your WP for 15-30% of the damage dealt!

passives.name: Absolve
passives.description: When healed, deal 60-80% of the healed amount to an enemy as magical damage.

passives.name: Safeguard
passives.description: Negate 20-40% of the damage dealt to you with WP.

passives.name: Critical
passives.description: Every attack has a 10-30% chance to deal 25-50% more damage. This can apply to heals.

passives.name: Discharge
passives.description: When WP is replenished, deal 110-150% of the replenished amount to an enemy as magical damage.

passives.name: Kamikaze
passives.description: When the animal dies, deal 50-75% of its Max HP as magical damage to the attacker.

passives.name: Regeneration
passives.description: Heal 5-10% of max HP after every turn.

passives.name: Energize
passives.description: Replenish 20-40 WP after every turn.

passives.name: Sprout
passives.description: Increase all incoming healing by +20-40%.

passives.name: Enrage
passives.description: Every 10% of missing health gives +2-5% damage.

passives.name: Sacrifice
passives.description: When this animal dies, heal your teammates for 25-50% of its Max HP and replenish for 15-35% of its Max WP.

passives.name: Snail
passives.description: Your pet snail fights with you. Whenever you attack an animal, snail will slap a random enemy for 5-15% of the damage dealt as true damage.

passives.name: Knowledge
passives.description: This passive does not do anything in battle. However, it will give this animal +5-15% extra XP after each battle.

passives.name: Giant Slayer
passives.description: Deal 10-25% more damage to bosses.

passives.name: Adaptation
passives.description: Gains resistance against the last damage type received. Physical hits grant stoneskin, while Magical hits grant spellskin. stoneskin - Reduces incoming Physical damage by 5-10% per stack. Remove all stacks upon taking damage of other types. spellskin - Reduces incoming Magical damage by 5-10% per stack. Remove all stacks upon taking damage of other types. 24px Stack Limit - Cannot exceed 5 stacks

passives.name: Resonance
passives.description: For every buff you have, deal +5-10% more damage. For every debuff you have, take -5-10% less damage.

passives.name: Living Hive
passives.description: When dealing damage, spend 8-2 WP to apply pest to the target. pest- At the end of the turn, each stack of pests will deal 2-8% of your MAG as magical damage to the target. Pests will leave after they deal damage.

passives.name: Lone Wolf
passives.description: If you are the only animal in your team, deal +10-30% more damage and take -10-30% less damage.

passives.name: Double Strike
passives.description: When this animal attacks, it has a 10-25%chance to attack one more time with 15-30% of the weapon's Effectiveness and 35-20% of the weapon's cost. 24px Unique Passive - This passive is only available once per weapon.

passives.name: Frost Armor
passives.description: When you receive damage, apply 10-20 stacks of frost to the attacker. frost At 100 stacks, apply a stack of freeze to the target. Remove all stacks after triggering. freeze Next turn, prevent the target from attacking. Remove a stack after triggering. |}
